items.name: Sentinel award, Q2 2026
items.claim: Northrop Grumman's second quarter 2026 significant new awards included $7.6 billion for the Sentinel program, $4.3 billion for restricted programs, $1.0 billion for F-35, $0.8 billion for Glide Phase Interceptor (GPI), and $0.7 billion for Multi-role Electronically Scanned Array (MESA).
items.source_excerpt: Awards and Backlog Second quarter 2026 net awards totaled $20.0 billion, and backlog totaled $104.7 billion. notes: Both items sourced from the stored Q2 2026 8-K earnings release (data/edgar/docs/NOC.json). The headline bullet rounds backlog to $105 billion while the body text states the precise $104.7 billion figure used here. Sentinel (a strategic missile replacement program) is the largest single named award and is directly relevant to the munitions-replenishment chain.
